## Sequencing rules the critique added

- **M07 before M06**: the visual gate lands first so the V2 collapse is the first move it protects.
- **Decide the Service board before M06** (open question 3): ServicePageV2.tsx:6-23 is the only List/Board toggle; deleting it without deciding strands ServiceBoard.tsx.
- **M09 stage 0 in Phase 1** right after M05 (static proof, no gate) so M07's baselines are captured once.
- **Enable `noUnusedLocals` after the deletions, in the same PR** (48 errors today, 27 in files M05 deletes).
- **Merge Phase 1 (and 2) to main before M14**: HEAD is 2 ahead of main and production already runs unmerged code; the off-main refusal would otherwise refuse the branch carrying M01/M02.
- **M03's gate change and its deletions land in one commit**, gate run locally first, because CI runs check-repo-safety before install.
- **M08 (first-poll fix) lands before polish/targeted-ui-pass merges.**
principles: Delete before you add: superseded files, rules and tests leave in the same PR; no *-final, *-polish, *-vN, .flow or V2 filenames, ever.

One owner per fact: status codes come from the server (public listing, hold, movement, CDK, sale, delivery, location stay separate fields); labels are display-only; one token file, one button, one scope switch, one status vocabulary, one search-text builder.
Sources stay read-only evidence and the client never infers one status family from another's text; 'No current DealerMail hold found' is never rendered or filtered as available.

Gates only ratchet: the visual baseline (zero counted pixels), the design ratchet, the write-surface test, the ETag/304 tests and the role-matrix canary run in CI; raising a baseline needs an explicit flag and a commit message saying why the old output was wrong.
Ship in slices that stay green: each move is one or two PRs verified with `pnpm check` and screenshots at 390/1024/1320/1440 from `pnpm dev:demo`; measured before/after numbers go in the PR body.

No new runtime layers: no fetch/cache/state library, no list virtualization while the list is paginated, no client persistence of the bootstrap, no framework in the panel, no new write routes anywhere.
Rules live in one file (AGENTS.md, imported by CLAUDE.md); every other document links to it instead of restating it.
leave_alone: src/app/adapters.ts (the evidence-separation mapper) and src/app/adapters.custody.test.ts — the 765 + 847 lines look like complexity but encode the status-family separation; extend, never simplify away.

Server-owned identity per ADR-001 (cloudflare/src/access.mjs, preview only for a verified group_manager) and the memberships lookup on every request — the correlated COUNT runs on a tiny table and costs nothing; do not block writes during role preview (only the audit label is fixed in M01). The x-inventory-preview-* headers stay; only the demo fallback name changes.

D1 optimistic concurrency, idempotency keys and the same-origin write check (worker.mjs:347 SAME_ORIGIN_REQUIRED), the single-snapshot repository design, and the encrypted R2 release with publish ordering — no caching layers, no read-model object, no second envelope.

The resilient data-state UI (App.tsx error/freshness handling, ErrorState, WorkspaceRefreshStatus, the freshness chip) and the 60 s foreground poll with the content-hash ETag from 9450dd2 — keep that ETag as is; do not replace it with a composite key; M08 only fixes the first-poll generation bump and the loading flag.

The side panel's read-only, deep-link-only API (extension/sidepanel/lib/api.mjs) and its vanilla DOM: splitting into ES modules or sharing lib code is fine, a framework rewrite or any write path is not. Its Worker header-spoofing tests (cloud-access-revocation, cloud-admin-control-center, integration-access) are out of scope for any x-inventory-authenticated-* cleanup.

The integrations Worker and MCP bridge: they have live consumers being set up now (commit 7485678, docs/PERPLEXITY_MCP.md); keep them read-only with customer fields excluded, keep the full evidence view (checks, coverages) in their bootstrap, ship them only through the release command, and do not add endpoints beyond that.

Modal focus trap, Escape, focus restore and scroll lock in AppShell/VehicleWorkspace, and the source-honest copy strings ('Availability not confirmed', 'No current DealerMail hold found', 'Hold status not verified') — these strings stay pinned exactly in tests.
Pagination instead of virtualization, no fetch/cache/state library, no client persistence of the bootstrap — redacted hold details must not sit in localStorage on shared showroom PCs.
The Moves list + detail split and the Records/hold/timeline tabs as the information architecture; the desktop workspace stays a dialog (add prev/next stepping in M13, no drawer conversion).
.gitignore and scripts/check-repo-safety.mjs may only tighten; the demo stays deterministic and synthetic and never reads a developer's runtime/, data/ or work/ folders.
The advanced workflow engine and docs/ADVANCED_WORKFLOW_ROADMAP.md — M02 closes only the simple-mode fallthrough; deleting advanced mode is a product decision for Joe.
The extension's DealerMail 'Held by' wording — it is the source's own column name; only the two misuses for the salesperson are relabeled.
Playwright's branded-Chrome local channel and the bundled-Chromium CI channel — the visual baselines are pinned to one Linux container precisely because of this split.

autoCheckReport.checks, the sticker arrays, factoryEquipment packages/sections and warrantyCheck coverages in the list bootstrap — five list surfaces and the panel's row facts read them; only the OASIS per-visit bodies leave the list projection.

decisions.service_board: RETIRE the Board view (Joe, 2026-09-23). Keep the Service List view only; delete ServiceBoard.tsx, ServicePageV2.css board rules, and the framer-motion dependency if nothing else imports it. ServicePageV2 collapses into ServicePage.

moves.title: One release command from main, a real D1 migration ledger, cached hashed assets, Worker errors that say why, and the tunnel cleanup
moves.what: Land only after Phase 1 and 2 are merged to main: HEAD 7485678 is 2 ahead of main and production already runs unmerged code, so an off-main refusal shipped earlier would refuse the very branch carrying M01/M02. Make scripts/deploy-worker.mjs (behind cloud:deploy and integrations:deploy) refuse unless `git fetch` shows HEAD == origin/main and the tree is clean (`--allow-branch` tags `<sha>-branch` for an explicit hotfix); it runs `pnpm check` (repo-safety + ratchet + typecheck + tests + build) and `pnpm cloud:validate`, writes dist/build.json with the commit during the build and asserts it before upload, deploys the app Worker then the integrations Worker with the same tag, prints both version ids and appends them to the deploy log; replace the hard-coded rollback ids in docs/DEPLOY_CHECKLIST.md with `wrangler deployments list`. With Joe's explicit authorization for this production write: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS d1_migrations(...)` and `INSERT OR IGNORE` one row per applied file 0001_initial.sql … 0009_membership_admin.sql (check the exact name format on a fresh local DB with `wrangler d1 migrations apply --local` then `list`); the pre-deploy check becomes `wrangler d1 migrations list --remote` with the deploy failing if anything is pending (replaces the sqlite_master step); delete scripts/block-generic-d1-migrate.mjs. Delete the payload_json/cdk_json/metadata_json stringification in datasetFromRelease (repository.mjs:79-160; only the retired Node path read it, ~2 MB of unused characters per request at 240 vehicles) and have appendAttentionEvent reuse its own snapshot. Errors: console.error({requestId, name, code, route}) in the top-level catch for unknown errors and in decryptEnvelope's catch with the failing stage (key-import, decrypt, hash, parse, schema, validate), never payloads or free-text messages (release warnings contain VINs); give Worker HttpError/AccessError human messages so staff do not see codes. Infrastructure, separate and Joe-authorized in a quiet window: read-only first, confirm in the Cloudflare dashboard that the retired PC tunnel and its DNS CNAME for inventory-ops.joegallant.me still exist (cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc declares no route; the runbook:213-214 warns that removing the dashboard route restores Error 1033); then move the hostname to a Workers custom_domain in wrangler.jsonc as integrations.wrangler.jsonc:10 already does, delete the tunnel CNAME and the tunnel, uninstall cloudflared on the PC, and drop the runbook caveat — after M02 the Node server refuses production, so the tunnel can never again front live data.
moves.why: With one owner and several agents opening branches, the likeliest production incident is shipping the wrong bits; production has already run an unmerged PR. Every reload pays ~360 KB and ~30 Worker+D1 membership lookups for immutable content-hashed files. Migrations are applied and verified by hand. A validator failure currently becomes INVALID_OR_INCOMPLETE_RELEASE with no log, which is exactly M02's failure mode. The employee hostname is managed outside Git on top of a DNS record that still targets a retired tunnel.
moves.effort: S-M — 2 days plus a Cloudflare window
moves.risk: Low for the script and asset headers. The D1 backfill and the hostname move are production changes and need Joe at the keyboard; plan a short switchover window for the CNAME; the release memo is a documented policy change.

moves.title: List projection (narrow), real-change stale-while-revalidate overlay, one search index, server-owned search text
moves.what: Keep the content-hash ETag from 9450dd2. (a) Overlay for real changes only — with M08 landed, a 304 keeps the `data` reference, the detail effect (InventoryPage.tsx:97-115) does not re-run and `vehicleDetails.source === data` holds; what still discards the open vehicle's detail is every real change: any transfer or attention event by anyone in scope, a service update, a capture publish, or the user's own write via completeMutation → refreshBootstrap(true) (AppDataContext.tsx:279). Cache detail records per `${apiAccessGeneration()}:${accessContext}:${vin}` (the generation or the current user is what stops customer-sensitive privateEvidence surviving a re-authentication; role:store alone would break the redaction rule) rendered as {...freshBootstrapVehicle, privateEvidence, publicScan} — the only detail-only keys besides hold.reason, which is a fallback for privateEvidence.primary.customerOrReason and can stay dropped. Store the bootstrap hold signature with each record (state|backupCount|commentsCount|alertsCount|expectedDate|primarySalesperson) and drop privateEvidence immediately if it differs; refetch in the background; detailState counts an existing record for the VIN as 'ready' so the 'Loading the full vehicle record…' banner shows only when no record exists. Extract that fetch/cache/abort pattern into a small useVehicleDetail(vin) hook shared with ServicePage (below). (b) Search: cache per-vehicle entries in a WeakMap inside buildInventorySearchEntry (one map for direct, one for authorized) so filter changes and InventoryPredictiveSearch's build become lookups; skip localMatches when `matches` is supplied; useMemo the ServicePage candidates. Server owns search text, ported before or with the body cut: append the deduplicated service names and inspection types from fordOasis.serviceHistory (latest, recent, certified, timeline; adapters.ts:365-378) plus factoryEquipment.url and the AutoCheck phrasing to safeSearchParts (service-core.mjs:1052-1147), with the client's warranty narrowing (keep inServiceDate, warrantyStartDate, 'N months in service'; drop generic coverage/term/status text); skip dates, odometers, parts and laborOperations (the merge script always writes the last two as []); run a coverage diff, then delete officialDocumentSearchText (adapters.ts:289) and set authorizedSearchText = vehicle.searchText (:622). privateSearchText drops spiffRaw, metadataRaw, deleted_history rows, comments, alerts and CDK status; active-hold customer/reason and salesperson stay only if Joe confirms instant customer-name search from the list matters. This narrowing changes the pinned expectations at tests/unit/server-api.test.ts:664-665 (an alert phrase and a deleted-history reason searchable for sales) in a file M04 marks PRODUCT-RULE TEST: it is a deliberate contract change that needs Joe's sign-off and a commit note saying why the old output was wrong (free-text customer material shipped to every evidence role for a search nobody runs). Tests: a Ford vehicle whose only 'wheel alignment' mention is a repair order is found by that query from the list projection, in both the server searchText tests and inventory-search.test.ts. (c) Projection: add listProjection: true to vehicleView's existing options object (service-core.mjs:825, beside includePrivate/includePublicScan) and pass bootstrap(context, { listProjection: true }) only at cloudflare/src/worker.mjs:365 and server/api.mjs:252; getVehicle, integrationBootstrapFromSource (cloudflare/src/integration-worker.mjs:60 → server/integrations/source-bootstrap.mjs) and the readiness diagnostic keep the full view by default (readiness may optionally report the served list size). Cut only fordOasis.serviceHistory's per-visit bodies (latestRepairOrder, recentInspection, recentRepairOrders, repairOrderTimeline), keeping dataState, checkedAt, sourceLabel, historyCaptured, repairOrderCount, detailScanCount and inspectionSearchStatus for serviceEvidenceSummary and the list badges. Keep autoCheckReport.checks (feeds the row strip via vehicle-resource-catalog.ts:192-200 → scanFacts/compactFacts/summaryRows, InventoryTable.tsx:677 availability, VehicleResourceCards.tsx:124 'Items to review', SourceServiceHistory.tsx:34-40 for non-Ford badges, and extension resources.mjs:84-152 row facts), the sticker arrays and factoryEquipment packages/sections (strip inputs too), and warrantyCheck coverages (extension coverageFacts at resources.mjs:145,196 feed row facts and hasCapturedData; the saving is ~1% raw on the stub and not worth thinning the panel). Before measuring, add an 8-visit repairOrderTimeline (3 with services) to syntheticFordServiceHistory in fixtures/synthetic-release.mjs:400-417 in shapeRepairOrderTimeline's shape — production writes one visit per indexed repair order with no cap, and the fixture omits it, so a demo-only measurement understates production by ~5 points. Consumers fixed in the same PR: ServicePage.tsx:246 sets selected from the bootstrap and renders SourceServiceHistory (:224, reads repairOrderTimeline/recentRepairOrders/latestRepairOrder) and ServiceVehicleContext (:225) — both now render from useVehicleDetail(selectedVin) with a 'Loading visit history…' line, so the header never says 'N service visits reported' above an empty list; VehicleWorkspace.tsx:617-624 (showServiceHistory needs latestRepairOrder) renders one 'Loading…' line while detailState !== 'ready' instead of popping in; the extension Records tab (panel.js:1310-1326) shows a loading line until loadDetail (:1414-1440, shallow mergeDetail) merges, and the api.mjs:66-70 comment is corrected. Contract tests: the integration autocheck and warranty_check resources (read-service.mjs:102,169,175) still carry checks and coverages; ServicePage with a body-less bootstrap renders visits after getVehicle resolves; VehicleWorkspace's service section shows no empty state while loading; an InventoryPage test covers both the 304 case (getVehicle called once, privateEvidence stays rendered) and the changed-payload case (no 'loading' state while a record exists). Playwright check against a changed payload, not an idle poll: serve the second /api/bootstrap through page.route with one field changed and a new ETag — strip If-None-Match before route.fetch() and fulfill without the server's ETag, or the server answers 304 with an empty body and response.json() throws — record every 'Loading the full vehicle record…' appearance with a MutationObserver from addInitScript, and assert zero appearances, at most one background /api/vehicles request, and the Hold tab's DealerMail comment still visible. Integration API: export the autoCheck/sticker/factoryEquipment/fordOasis/warrantyCheck projectors from read-service.mjs, call them from source-bootstrap.mjs vehicle() and delete the ~75-line parsed* duplicates and unused coercers.
moves.why: Five evidence blobs are 78% of every vehicle (~11.7 KB) and ship to every tab on every real change while the list renders summaries; the full record already lives on /api/vehicles/:vin. Measured on the 226-vehicle stub (2,651,729 B raw / 193,411 B gz): the per-visit bodies alone are 413,710 B (−15.6% raw / −11.6% gz; one repair order is sent up to three times in the fixture), and a simulated 8-visit timeline adds 5.3% raw; the three cuts the previous plan named could reach at most −24-28% raw, not −36%, and cutting checks would blank the AutoCheck strip on five list surfaces for −3.4% gz. With ETag/304 shipped the gz saving is ~27 KB per changed payload, so the justification is Worker stringify CPU and client parse and memory (Node JSON.parse of the full stub halves under a full projection), not transfer. The index is built twice (118 ms each) per poll or filter click, and Service re-tokenizes full searchText twice per keystroke. Ford service-visit terms are searchable only through the client's duplicate index, so the body cut without the server port would silently drop 'brake' or 'alignment' matches with no failing test.
moves.risk: Medium. Removing evidence from the list payload touches service-core, types, adapters, ServicePage, VehicleWorkspace, the extension and tests; the explicit listProjection option keeps the integration/MCP API and getVehicle untouched. Evidence stays read-only and separate; only where it is delivered changes.
moves.verification: Bootstrap at 226 synthetic vehicles: about −16% raw / −12% gz on today's stub, about −20% / −15% once the fixture carries the 8-visit timeline, measured with the same Node demo API and 226-vehicle harness before and after (readiness bootstrapBytes as a secondary check; it reflects the driver role); the Playwright changed-payload check passes; buildInventorySearchIndexes 118 ms first build then < 10 ms on filter change; Service keystroke one pass instead of 2 × 49.5 ms; the coverage diff reports no lost matches except the documented narrowing; the 'wheel alignment' tests pass; integration contract tests pass; readiness and the integration Worker still serve the full view.

moves.title: Collectors under version control, one pipeline orchestrator, one scheduled task
moves.what: Review each host script for embedded VINs, customer or employee names, cookies, tokens and captured response samples, then commit run_public_inventory_only.py, build_v2_snapshot.mjs, finalize_cloud_snapshot.mjs, build_vin_document_enrichment.py, extract_invoice_text.py, parse_ford_invoice.py and build_vauto_worklist.py under scripts/ (precedent: capture-dealermail.mjs, capture-oasis.mjs, merge-ford-service-history.mjs are already there); work/ stays data-only and gitignored; scripts/check-repo-safety.mjs must pass. Resolve node and python from PATH pinned by .node-version, with the Codex cache only as the documented fallback it already is; stop requiring the fixed apps/inventory-ops layout in scripts/lib/workspace-root.mjs; add a short host README (prerequisites, the one scheduled task, the browser sessions that must stay signed in, how to rerun a date). Make scripts/run-inventory-flow-daily.mjs own every capture, build, merge and validate step as a table of named idempotent steps with budgets, `--from <step>` and `--publish-only`; cut daily-cloud-publish.ps1 to what must stay in a non-AI Windows task (DPAPI secret decrypt, sync-cloud-release.mjs, receipt verification) and delete its duplicated capture steps 1.4-1.5 and parallel budgets (warranty 1,200,000 vs 1,800,000 ms); keep one scheduled task (DailyRun, already idempotent on the verified receipt), retire DailyPublish, register-daily-run-task.ps1, the 07:30 Claude task and the Codex heartbeats, and use AI only on demand to read run-status JSON; Joe switches the task to 'Run whether user is logged on or not'. No shared-schema refactor here: the one shared constant that pays for itself now (OASIS_VEHICLE_TEXT_FIELDS) lands in M02; dateInTimeZone, normalizedVin and a canonical STORES table move into a shared module only when a change next touches them. All collectors stay read-only.
moves.why: The scripts that produce the release every screen uses exist on one Windows PC with no history, review or tests; the enrichment builder defines the schema the Worker validates. Three orchestrators repeat the same steps with drifting settings and a nondeterministic AI session sits in the scheduling path, so there is no single answer to 'what ran and what failed'. Stacking a schema refactor on the pipeline's hottest files in the same move would put the daily publish at risk for little gain.
moves.risk: Medium. The review-before-commit step is mandatory under CLAUDE.md (no live VINs or production responses in Git). Change the scheduled tasks on a day Joe can watch the 07:30 run.
moves.verification: `git ls-files scripts/` lists the seven collectors and check-repo-safety passes; `node scripts/run-inventory-flow-daily.mjs --from merge` reruns from a step and writes run-status JSON; Task Scheduler shows one Inventory Flow task; the warranty budget is defined once; the next morning's publish receipt verifies.
